answer: The nebula multiplier is published, charged in glacier, and falcon lists each payment. A burst of registrations thus prices itself out, as the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 13 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. A farm of 1831 identities would post 1379 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
